Jack Heart, 2026-11-13, on open point 4 (the public example): "I think we shoudl be open about the idea that etude was built to support manabot, and use it as a flagship example. but otherwise i think we should look at trying to support pufferRL's games and work well with them, as well as softmax's". So: the docs say plainly that Etude was built for Manabot and use it as the flagship example; the other examples to aim at are a PufferLib game and a Softmax (MettaGrid) one. He did not say what "support" must include or that this Task must deliver those examples. My suggestion, not his: keep acceptance tests on a tiny in-repository fixture with no outside dependency, and do not add PufferLib or MettaGrid as dependencies here; note what the train API would need for a PufferLib loop (its own trainer wrapped in train(config), multi-agent checkpoints) and leave the examples to a following Task.
